note.zh-TW: 課程只在說明每股盈餘的股數變化時提到庫藏股，故事沒有用到；這張卡是網站補充的延伸內容，不列入期中考範圍。
note.en: The course mentions treasury shares only when explaining changes in the share count for earnings per share; the story does not use them. This card is extension content added by the site and is outside the midterm scope.

definition.zh-TW: 公司用自己的現金從市場買回來、還沒註銷的自家股票。買回時現金減少、權益也減少（以減項列示），不是資產；買回後流通在外的股數變少，計算每股盈餘的股數時要扣除。
definition.en: A company’s own shares that it has bought back with its cash and not yet cancelled. On the buyback, cash falls and equity falls (shown as a deduction); treasury shares are not an asset. Fewer shares remain outstanding afterwards, so they are excluded from the share count when earnings per share is calculated.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IAS 32 規定庫藏股自權益中扣除，買賣自家股票不認列損益。
ifrsNote.en: Under IAS 32 treasury shares are deducted from equity, and no gain or loss is recognised on buying or selling a company’s own shares.
